Top Ag
Southwestern Illinois Ag Cooperative
Contact Us
An independent, farmer-owned agricultural cooperative, Top Ag serves farmers and homeowners throughout Southwestern Illinois. Our integrated network of locations and trusted suppliers has provided quality farm supply products and services to our members and local communities for generations.
We believe in the impact of agriculture on our community and the world, and we are committed to the growth and sustainability of family-owned farming operations throughout the region. We have 11 locations covering several counties and offer agronomy, feed, grain, and propane services and products.
What We Do
Agronomy
Maximize your yield with our agronomy products and services. Our educated, experienced, and expert agronomists can advise you on crop nutrients, crop protection, seed, custom applications, and financing options that fit your budget.
Agronomy Services
Feed
As a Purina Certified Expert Dealer, we provide Southwestern Illinois animal owners and farmers with a full line of quality feed products that guarantee optimal livestock nutrition.
Feed Services
Grain
Our ten grain facilities have more than 12 million bushels of storage capacity at competitive bid prices. We continually upgrade and expand our grain storage locations for increased speed, flexibility, and access. Buy, sell, and store your grain with Top Ag.
Grain Services
Propane
Top Ag supplies residential and agricultural propane to customers across the region. We offer convenient budget billing and prepay options, so you never have to worry about powering your home or operations.
Propane Services
Top Ag Complete
Check balances, make payments, request quotes, and access contracts – all in real-time and all in one place – with our easy-to-use customer portal. Whether you utilize Top Ag for one service or several, conveniently manage your account with the Top Ag Complete App.
Customer Login

Enhancing Illinois Agriculture Through Generations
Top Ag was established as a farmer’s co-op in 1919. Since then, we have worked with farmers and residents throughout the region to invest in and build our communities by supporting schools, businesses, and other local organizations.
Our ag cooperative is focused on providing quality service and top-of-the-line products to enhance your farming operations and grow the places where we live and work. From construction on our first grain elevator to our most recent propane and agronomy facility purchase, we’re always looking to expand our offerings and empower future farmers for generations to come.
About Top Ag
Find a Career in Agriculture
Our success is tied to our employees. At Top Ag, you will find a safe, team-oriented environment that focuses on empowering our local communities. We offer competitive pay and excellent benefits for anyone wanting to kickstart their career in agriculture or agribusiness. Internships are also available to students looking to gain hands-on skills and discover opportunities within the agronomy field.
Top Ag Careers
Explore Our Top Ag Locations
Our ag supply network has ties throughout Southern Illinois. We work hard to provide exceptional customer service and have trusted sales representatives available to offer personalized assistance. Explore our offerings by location or connect with our team to learn more about a partnership with Top Ag.
